analysis.plain_explanation: You bought a phone for Rs 18,000 using UPI on October 20, 2026, from MobileMart24, but it was never delivered and the seller is not responding. You have the right to seek a full refund for undelivered goods under consumer and contract laws. Since the payment was made via UPI, you should immediately report the transaction to your bank and the national cyber crime reporting portal if it qualifies as an online fraud. You can also file a complaint through the National Consumer Helpline or approach the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission if the seller continues to ignore you. However, refunds cannot be guaranteed, and outcomes depend on the evidence you provide and the response of the seller or bank.

steps.title: Contact the seller in writing
steps.detail: Send a final written demand to MobileMart24 attaching your order confirmation, UPI payment receipt, and chat proof, asking for a full refund for the undelivered phone.
steps.where: Email or customer support chat of MobileMart24

steps.title: Call National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
steps.detail: Register a pre-litigation grievance against MobileMart24 by calling 1915 or using the INGRAM portal with your payment and order details.

steps.title: Report at cybercrime.gov.in / 1930
steps.detail: Report the online financial fraud and non-delivery scam immediately on the national cyber crime reporting portal to protect your financial interests.

steps.title: Inform your bank about the disputed transaction
steps.detail: Contact your bank's customer support immediately to report the unauthorized or fraudulent UPI transaction and check for chargeback options.
steps.where: Your bank's official customer care or branch

steps.title: File a consumer complaint on the e-Jagriti portal
steps.detail: If MobileMart24 fails to refund, file a formal consumer complaint online on the e-Jagriti portal since the amount paid is up to Rs 50 lakh.

plan.summary: You have solid evidence including order confirmation, UPI receipt, and unresponded chat logs. Since MobileMart24 failed to deliver your phone, you should report the matter to NCH 1915, the cybercrime portal 1930, notify your bank, and if needed, file a formal complaint on the e-Jagriti portal.

draft_document.text:
To,
MobileMart24

Subject: Legal notice for non-delivery of phone and demand for full refund of Rs 18,000

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, [YOUR NAME], placed an order for a mobile phone on 20 Oct 2026 with your platform MobileMart24 and paid an amount of Rs 18,000 via UPI on the same date, vide transaction reference [TRANSACTION ID].

Although the payment was successfully processed, you have failed to deliver the phone to date. Furthermore, despite multiple attempts to contact your support team through chat messages, you have completely ignored my requests and failed to provide any resolution or refund.

Your failure to deliver the goods or refund the money amounts to a deficiency in service and an unfair trade practice under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019. 

Through this notice, I call upon you to refund the entire amount of Rs 18,000 along with appropriate compensation within 7 days of receiving this notice. If you fail to do so, I shall be forced to initiate legal proceedings against you before the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission and other appropriate forums at your risk and cost.

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
[YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION]
Date: [DATE]
